name: Yo Zaizen
source:
As the designated voice of her people— the sole star in a field of asteroids— Yo Zaizen purposefully ties herself to her traditional background with careful ease. Whether through her formal attire, or her meek, endearingly quiet personality, she treads incredibly lightly through casual conversation. She only speaks when she has something to say, or, at the very least, a troublesome worry to voice.

Of course, her meager tongue is equally representative of her confidence— or the lack thereof. While she does remaining well-kept and observant, she lets her lesser qualities eat away at her like leeches. Building up courage is a difficult task for Yo, as she'd rather watch from the sidelines, and swallow her honest, all-consuming feelings.
